summary: Count colors to identify the modal background, the endpoint color appearing exactly twice, the high-frequency stripe color, and the medium-frequency waypoint color. Normalize vertical stripes by transposition. Starting below the upper endpoint, descend to one row above each ordered stripe, move horizontally to the middle of its three-cell waypoint run, punch through that cell, and continue; after the final stripe descend to the lower endpoint row and hook horizontally to it, preserving every cell outside the endpoint-colored route.
